source: Forecasts: team strategy note, section 3.4 (Tables 9–12) and Appendix B targets. Actuals: Cesim Round 1–3 results, Universe 5.

internal.name: Ending inventory (value)
internal.cause: Production at 100–105% of a forecast that assumed higher shares than we won, so unsold cars piled up at cost.
internal.action: Produce = next-round sales target − cars in stock; cut combustion by 290k and hybrid by 90k.
internal.alert: Ending inventory above 5% of cars sold

internal.name: Unplanned short-term debt
internal.cause: R1: 6.0 bn debt repaid (plan 3.0) and 3.6 bn paid out while 10.1 bn sat in stock.
internal.action: Decide finance last; check Projections cash in every area; internal loans to China and Europe.

internal.name: Cash at end of round
internal.cause: Same drivers as I2 in R1–R2; a 13.1 bn buyback in R3.
internal.action: Keep cash of at least 10% of revenue; distributions never above the round's profit.

internal.name: Net profit for the round
internal.cause: Plan assumed hybrids at 22–30% of our cars; they were 41–45%, at higher prices.
internal.action: Re-base the forecast each round on the outlook and the actual mix.
internal.alert: Forecast error on profit or cars sold above ±10%

internal.name: Long-term debt
internal.cause: R3 borrowed 3.0 bn to fund a 13.1 bn buyback (plan 4.0 bn).
internal.action: No borrowing to buy back shares; steady dividend of about USD 2 per share.
internal.alert: New long-term debt in a round with a buyback; equity ratio outside 45–60%

external.name: ESG: environmental score
external.cause: Higher CO2 per car and weaker process improvements than RedBull and Great.
external.action: Renewable energy to 70% in China and US plants; process improvements in China; Silver certification.
external.alert: E score below rival average; renewables below 50%
external.rivals: Great (premium, sustainability: ESG 3.43, E 3.90) and RedBull (premium: E up to 3.41, CO2 1,227 kg per car).

external.name: Pricing: hybrid price index
external.cause: Hybrids priced at market while offering more features (3.67 vs 3.0 in R3).
external.action: Price within ±2% of the best-selling rival when our features are equal or higher.
external.alert: Index below 98 with a feature lead
external.rivals: RedBull (premium pricer: +5.8% vs average, feature costs 8.0% of sales, EBITDA 25.4%).

external.name: Promotion
external.cause: Cut to 2.1 bn in R3 to protect margin while Blue kept 2.66 bn.
external.action: About 2.5 bn, weighted to the USA and China hybrid.
external.rivals: Blue (value for features, promotion-led, top hybrid share 24.4%) and Orange (cost leader, volume).

external.name: Capacity planning: ending inventory
external.cause: Rivals produce to demand and run lean; we kept contract volume on top of in-house plants.
external.action: Production from the Sales hand-off; in-house 85–90%; contract only for confirmed demand.
external.alert: Our inventory above rival average; in-house utilisation below 80%
external.rivals: Orange (1.2 bn stock, China plants at 100%) and Blue (1.7 bn, lowest hybrid unit cost USD 17,051).

external.name: Technology: China hybrid features
external.cause: 3 features offered although 4 were available, while Blue moved to 5.
external.action: Offer the maximum available; licence a 5th feature if R&D cannot deliver in time.
external.alert: Our features below the market leader in any hybrid market
external.rivals: Blue (5 features at RMB 175,000, 34.9% share) and Orange (premium niche, 4 features at RMB 212,000).
